text: Damn mate, what an old car I have, what am I supposed to do now?
I see your metal beast broke, you seem to have pretty bad luck my friend.
What? Who's there?
How unfortunate! I know this forest like my right hand that I no longer have, and I know there is no one who can help you out except me! Which I won't do.
Just kidding! There is a metal beast graveyard nearby. Perhaps there is something useful.
Ok sure, whatever you say I guess.
Alright, I found the battery. Now I just have to find my way back.
Bravo!! You found the life saver of the metal beast!
Yeah, I did. Now I just have to fix it.
With what?
Right..
You need some tools my lovely friend! You may find some in the place where dead people rest..
A graveyard?
Perhaps.
A wrench. This should do.
I found a wrench.
Lovely! Now you can change the battery.
Wonderful! Though I have to tell you, your tire looks a bit flat. Get a new one, it hurts my eyes to see it like that!
Follow that path and look for it.
It didn't look flat before..
Oh how the magic happens!
This gives me chills.
Finally. Now I quickly have to get back to my car before someone tries to stop me again.
You made it! Now just change the tires, and make it quick! I hate seeing them so deflated!
Alright finally. I'm leaving this place for good! Appreciate the help.. I guess?
You got lucky my friend! This place eats cars!
Yeah... I'm not walking out there.
Ugh... what a horrible dream...
That felt way too real for a nightmare...
I'm awake... right? Please let me be awake.
